findings.title: BUG-132 fix exists only on open PR #61 — unmerged, and the PR author's own end-to-end on-device acceptance is still pending
findings.failure_scenario: If the feat/browser-always-available branch is not merged, main (and any release built from it) still carries the un-keyed _tool_defs_cache_key: a tool catalog computed while the browser relay was down is memoized without TTL and replayed browser-less for the process lifetime — browser_* tools permanently invisible to the agent even after the relay arms. Even on the fix branch, the author notes the fresh-boot acceptance test did not complete (USB dropped).
